sources.name: Fortune
sources.title: South Korea faces an AI cheating scandal days before its national college entrance exams
sources.description: South Korea’s top scorer on the national tax accountant qualification exam has admitted to using AI to cheat. Han Won-seok revealed in a video posted on his lawyer’s YouTube channel that he used a small camera to photograph exam questions, sent the images to an AI tool, and checked the answers on his smartphone.
